Alex: Morning — quick async. Preflight for the small-tilt tonight. Did: opened PR #4872 to raise AMS spot buffer by 15%.
Maria: Nice. Blocker: cloud quota team asked for justification doc. I've drafted one (link: https://go/rem/4872-doc) but need a few numbers from telemetry.
Alex: I can pull 24h QPS and spike percent from the dashboard. Will paste in a bit.
ops-bot: Deploy check: canary nodes healthy in us-west-2. All green :white_check_mark: (uptime 99.98%)
Jen: What I did: validated the prewarm script against a replica lane; timings look ok. Blocker: a flaky test in the KV cache that fails ~1/300 runs.
Sam: Today: I'll take the KV test flakiness. If I can't repro locally I'll try a soak in staging. Also will follow up with quota team for approval.
Alex: Telemetry snapshots: 24h p95 token latency 38ms, 99th 210ms during the tilt window; spike at 04:10 UTC accounted for 9% increase. Adding to PR description.
Maria: Added the justification to PR. @Sam, pinging quota@cloud for review — here's the message I sent: "Requesting temporary spot buffer bump +15% for AMS to support tilt prewarm. Attached telemetry and rollback plan."
Sam: 👍 queued a follow-up with quota team, asked for reply within 4 hrs. If denied, fallback plan is to route 30% of prewarm to eu-west-1.
Jen: Note: if we shift to eu-west-1, we need to adjust the prewarm concurrency param from 12 -> 8 to keep latency SLO. I can prep a quick config PR.
Alex: Action items: Sam follow quota, Jen prepare config PR, Alex will merge telemetry into PR once quota approves. Ops-bot, can you post a reminder 3h before the tilt?
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: 3 hours before tilt at 2026-03-18T18:00:00Z. :alarm_clock:
Maria: tiny ask — can someone do a short smoke when tilt starts? I'll be on a call but can check post-mortem logs.
Jen: I'll run the smoke and paste results here. If anything >5% error rate, we'll pause prewarm and fallback.
Alex: Thanks team. Keeping thread open, update here when quota responds. End.
